title: Monkey Man

ai_content.desc_en: Monkey Man tells the story of an anonymous young man known as Monkey Man, who is beaten and brutalized in a secret underground fight club. After years of suppressed rage, Monkey Man discovers a way to infiltrate the enclave of the city's sinister elite, and begins a powerful campaign of retribution to settle the score with the men who have wronged him. Monkey Man tries to play by the rules of this underground world, but he finds himself trapped between his anger and the bloodlust that drives him.
